aws_cloudtrail_new_channel_trigger.description: Runs for each new channel in AWS CloudTrail. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields ChannelArn, Name

aws_cloudtrail_new_event_data_store_trig.description: Runs for each new event data store in AWS CloudTrail. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields EventDataStoreArn, Name, TerminationProtectionEnabled, Status, AdvancedEventSelectors, MultiRegionEnabled, OrganizationEnabled, RetentionPeriod, CreatedTimestamp, UpdatedTimestamp

aws_cloudtrail_new_event_trigger.description: Runs for each new event in AWS CloudTrail. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields EventId, EventName, ReadOnly, AccessKeyId, EventTime, EventSource, Username, Resources, CloudTrailEvent

aws_cloudtrail_new_or_updated_channel_tr.description: Runs each time a channel added or changes in AWS CloudTrail. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields ChannelArn, Name

aws_cloudtrail_new_or_updated_event_data.description: Runs each time an event data store added or changes in AWS CloudTrail. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields EventDataStoreArn, Name, TerminationProtectionEnabled, Status, AdvancedEventSelectors, MultiRegionEnabled, OrganizationEnabled, RetentionPeriod, CreatedTimestamp, UpdatedTimestamp

aws_cloudtrail_new_or_updated_trail_trig.description: Runs each time a trail added or changes in AWS CloudTrail. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields TrailARN, Name, HomeRegion

aws_cloudtrail_new_trail_trigger.description: Runs for each new trail in AWS CloudTrail. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
